szenen.vo: [shouting] Stop waiting for motivation, bro! [intense] Motivation is a feeling, and feelings don't care about your goals.
[intense] One day you're on fire, the next day you can't even get out of bed.
[intense] Discipline doesn't ask how you feel. Discipline just shows up.
[intense] When nobody is watching, when nobody claps, you still do the work.
[shouting] Tired? Do it anyway! Bored? Do it anyway!
[shouting] Because motivated people start, but disciplined people finish. Every single time!
[intense] You will never feel ready. Nobody ever does.
[intense] So stop negotiating with yourself and show up for one more day.
[shouting] Then do it again tomorrow. Every! Single! Day!
